name: Zivotofsky, by His Parents and Guardians Zivotofsky et ux. v. Clinton, Secretary of State
name_abbreviation: Zivotofsky ex rel. Zivotofsky v. Clinton

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: Zivotofsky, by His Parents and Guardians Zivotofsky et ux. v. Clinton, Secretary of State.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted. In addition to the question presented by the petition, the parties are directed to brief and argue the following question: “Whether § 214 of the Foreign Relations Authorization Act, Fiscal Year 2003, impermissibly infringes the President’s power to recognize foreign sovereigns.”

casebody.head_matter:
No. 10-699.
Zivotofsky, by His Parents and Guardians Zivotofsky et ux. v. Clinton, Secretary of State.
